title: Luna: document the portable style-profile contract
description:
Implements LIM-2a1ca5 after its configuration tests are stable.

Scope:
- Add a concise README section with a complete portable profile example and command examples.
- Explain reference sample paths, optional rules and checks, density settings, validation behavior, and the detector-score prohibition.
- Ensure every documented command runs against checked-in fixtures.

Definition of done:
- A fresh user can create a profile and run diagnose using only this repository.
- Documentation names no Papyrus dependency.
- Examples are exercised by an automated test or a documented verification command.

Out of scope: SDK and apply workflow documentation.
